facts.fact: The CIL, headed by president Dr Halguieta Nassa/Trawina, reported its 2022 activities to the Head of State in February 2024.
facts.system: Commission de l'informatique et des libertes (CIL)

facts.fact: The CIL president reported that in 2022 about 15,000 people were trained, over 190 personal data projects were processed as formalities and about a hundred complaints were registered.
